{{Quote|The Itani Nebula used to be the haven for a small band of pirates. They'd hide their strike ships just within the nebula, masking their profiles and locations from ships en route to Darknon Station. These swift ships could easily jump out at any prey veering near the nebula, and would quickly disable, board and loot such target ships.|[[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]|<ref name="PSG" />}}
The '''Itani Nebula''' was a vast [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that was made up of reddish-green [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]], small infant [[Star/Legends|stars]], and flashing [[Ion storm/Legends|ion]] and [[Magnetic storm/Legends|magnetic storms]].

==History==
The Itani Nebula was hazardous to navigate.<ref name="PSG" />

[[File:Itani_Map_Hydian_Way.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] (white) and the [[Itani Run]] (yellow).]]
The Itani Nebula was one of the many hazards along the route which [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] charted for the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. She blazed a line across the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in [[3703 BBY|3703]] and [[3702 BBY]] which was integrated into the first Hydian Way. A new line was later discovered and Kallea's first segment became the [[Itani Run]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Darknon Station]] was located along the [[Itani Run]], which skirted the edge of the nebula. A secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial research station (Itani Nebula)|research station]] was hidden inside the Itani Nebula.<ref name="PSG" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Alliance fleet|portion]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]], commanded by the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']], was [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|ambushed]] by an Imperial [[Shadow Squadron (Itani Nebula)|unit]] commanded by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] who flew as [[Shadow Leader]].<ref name="TFU2c">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Itani Nebula was home to a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Larken]]. The pirates mysteriously [[Ambush near Darknon Station|disappeared]] when they took on a [[Kizbon's Box|target]] too big for their own guns.<ref name="AJ5" /><ref name="PSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|comic adaption]] of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' mistakenly places the Itani Nebula in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TFU2c" />
